- Bulma 1.0.1 — https://github.com/jgthms/bulma — MIT
- Font Awesome Free 5.15.3 — https://fontawesome.com/license/free
- Academicons 1.9.1 — https://github.com/jpswalsh/academicons — font SIL OFL 1.1, CSS MIT
